title: Furnace, Kiln, Oven, Drier, and Kettle Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend heating equipment other than basic metal, plastic, or food processing equipment. Includes activities such as annealing glass, drying lumber, curing rubber, removing moisture from materials, or boiling soap.

tasks.text: Monitor equipment operation, gauges, and panel lights to detect deviations from standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Confer with supervisors or other equipment operators to report equipment malfunctions or to resolve production problems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis support good; physical resolution needs humans

dwas.name: Confer with others to resolve production problems or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Press and adjust controls to activate, set, and regulate equipment according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Record gauge readings, test results, and shift production in log books.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Read and interpret work orders and instructions to determine work assignments, process specifications, and production schedules.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Examine or test samples of processed substances, or collect samples for laboratory testing, to ensure conformance to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical/physical testing requires lab manipulation

dwas.name: Test chemical or physical characteristics of materials or products.

tasks.text: Transport materials and products to and from work areas, manually or using carts, handtrucks, or hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.

tasks.text: Stop equipment and clear blockages or jams, using fingers, wire, or hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically clearing jams in machinery

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.

tasks.text: Load equipment receptacles or conveyors with material to be processed, by hand or using hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Remove products from equipment, manually or using hoists, and prepare them for storage, shipment, or additional processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Calculate amounts of materials to be loaded into furnaces, adjusting amounts as necessary for specific conditions.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.

tasks.text: Melt or refine metal before casting, calculating required temperatures, and observe metal color, adjusting controls as necessary to maintain required temperatures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
Melt metal, plastic, or other materials to prepare for production.

tasks.text: Weigh or measure specified amounts of ingredients or materials for processing, using devices such as scales and calipers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Direct crane operators and crew members to load vessels with materials to be processed.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Feed fuel, such as coal and coke, into fireboxes or onto conveyors, and remove ashes from furnaces, using shovels and buckets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Replace worn or defective equipment parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Clean, lubricate, and adjust equipment, using scrapers, solvents, air hoses, oil, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.
